title: 4-round AES-256: 25-byte function parameterization

target.description: 4 inner AES rounds, without initial whitening and with MixColumns in every round, under fixed round keys. The parameter-independent round argument applies to the standard AES-256 schedule.

setting.key_relation: 4 fixed round keys; the structural argument does not use key-schedule relations.
setting.key_population: General fixed key; no weak-key restriction.
setting.plaintext_model: One byte takes all 256 values while the other fifteen bytes are fixed.

property.statement: With one active input byte and all other input bytes fixed, each four-round output byte is a function described by at most 25 fixed byte parameters.
property.quantifier: For each fixed choice of passive input bytes and round keys, one parameter tuple describes all 256 active-input values. The parameter count is not a lower bound or a number of independent key bytes.
property.scope: Proposition4 constructs four shared first-round offsets, sixteen second-round offsets, four third-round diagonal key bytes and one fourth-round output key byte.

parameters.name: Active input values
parameters.meaning: Full byte range in one input position; other fifteen positions fixed.

parameters.name: Fixed parameter bytes
parameters.meaning: 20 key/passive-dependent offsets and 5 selected round-key bytes.

validation.description: Source symbolic dependency argument. An independent local AES component checker verifies 1536 four/five-round evaluations from a separately derived 25-parameter factorization; literal printed recurrences have documented discrepancies.

field_conflicts.label: Printed function expansion
field_conflicts.description: The recurrence preceding Proposition2 omits the third-round S-boxes. Printed Equation(1) also differs from the second-round diagonal expressions immediately above it. A separately derived 25-parameter AES factorization passes local component tests; the printed expressions are preserved as discrepant. DTCB09 explicitly corrects Equation1 and the C3_22/C3_44 expansions in Equations2/4, while stating that these errors do not affect DS08 attack applicability. Separate corrected AES factorization is supported, not the literal print.

observations.locator: Printed p.119 recurrence preceding Proposition2; p.120 Equation(1)
observations.reported: The p.119 recurrence is linear in second-round bytes without S-boxes; Equation(1) uses different coefficients for its c4 and c3 terms.

observations.locator: Printed p.119 second-round diagonal equations; p.117 AES round definition
observations.reported: SubBytes precedes ShiftRows/MixColumns every inner round. C2_22=S(3t11+c4)+c6 and C2_33=2S(t11+c3)+c7 require different nested terms in C3_11.

observations.locator: PDF5/printed148 Section4, Equations3–6; PDF4/printed147 corrected recurrence.
observations.reported: Explicit correction of DS08 Equation1 and C3_22/C3_44; authors state no effect on applicability of DS08 attacks.
